name: comp-127

frames.best_why: The four arrow tiles ring the centre dot cleanly with no cursor touching them.

tagline: Four arrow tiles around a dot for nudging a view four ways.
summary: A small cross-shaped pad of four outlined icon buttons, one per direction, arranged around a plain circle marker. Hovering an arrow lightens its tile; it is made for panning a camera or map.
appearance: Four dark rounded square buttons with thin outlines form a cross on a near-black stage: a chevron up on top, left and right in the middle row, and down at the bottom. A small white ring sits in the gap at the centre.
behaviour: Hovering any arrow brightens its tile and focus rings it; pressing is meant to pan the view that way, but nothing on the pad itself moves or updates.
search_phrases: pan camera up down left right
use_when: A 3D viewer, map or canvas needs simple four-way nudge buttons rather than drag gestures.
avoid_when: Only four directions exist, no buttons carry handlers, and diagonal or continuous movement is unsupported.
customise: There are no props: the four directions, their labels and the centre marker are fixed and no handlers are wired, so behaviour means a source edit.
weight_why: Four outlined icon buttons and a centre dot; nothing animates.

a11y.note: Each arrow is labelled by direction and focus is ringed, but no button is wired to any actual movement.

issues: Only four directions are offered and none of the buttons has an action attached.
polish_why: Even, readable d-pad; plain outlined buttons with no working movement.
